'''Kurzen's Compound''' is an unusual human settlement located east of the [[Rebel Camp]] in [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. The humans here are led by [[Colonel Kurzen]], and attack both [[Alliance]] and [[Horde]]. 

The inhabitants of the Rebel Camp were once members of the compound before rebelling after Kurzen descended into madness. They are embroiled in a deadly conflict with the jungle fighters. It has a [[lumber mill]] and at the back of the Compound is a non-instanced dungeon, the [[Stockpile]], where the fighters keep their equipment. The men also keep [[Panther]]s and [[Stranglethorn Tiger]]s in cages near the [[stables]] so they can be trained to become [[Kurzen War Panther]]s and [[Kurzen War Tiger]]s.

==Trivia==
* Kurzen's Compound is most likely in reference to Colonel Kurtz's compound from the movie {{wp|Apocalypse Now}}.
